title: Ariadne Policy Document
description: Schema for Ariadne YAML policy documents that define capability rules for engagement profiles.

name.description: Unique name of this policy document (e.g. 'base', 'htb', 'private-lab').

version.description: Monotonic version number for the policy schema.

capabilities.description: Mapping of capability names to their rules.

allowed.description: Whether this capability is permitted. Default false (fail-closed).

always_manual.description: If true, this capability always requires manual user approval.

max_rate.description: Maximum requests per second for this capability.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent operations for this capability.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts per target for this capability.

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock duration in seconds for this capability.

max_output_bytes.description: Maximum output size in bytes for this capability.

allowed_tools.description: Set of allowed tool names for this capability.
